description: This file contains the implementation of the Store controller class within the admin setting namespace of the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It manages various store-related administrative functions such as listing stores, editing store details, and creating new store configurations. The class provides methods for rendering forms, handling form submissions, listing existing stores with pagination, and loading store-specific configurations. It interacts with models related to store settings, layouts, themes, and images, and constructs data for views that enable administrators to manage store details effectively.

classes.name: Store
classes.description: Controller class for managing store settings in the admin panel of OpenCart. Handles listing, editing, creating, and deleting store records, as well as loading store configurations and rendering the associated views.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point that initializes the store management page, loading language files, setting the document title, preparing breadcrumbs, and rendering the store list view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the request to list stores, loads necessary language files, and outputs the store list view with pagination.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML view for listing stores, including fetching store data, handling pagination, and preparing data for the view.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Renders the form view for creating or editing a store, pre-loading store data if editing an existing store.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes the submission of the store form to create or update store information.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles the deletion of selected store records.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving store configuration settings, including permission validation, input validation, model interactions for adding or updating store data, and returns a JSON response indicating success or error messages.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles deletion of selected store entries, including permission validation, removing store and configuration data, and returning a JSON response.
